definition_ja: ある基底での座標を別の基底での座標に書き換えること。その対応を表す行列を基底変換行列という。
definition_en: Rewriting coordinates relative to one basis as coordinates relative to another; the matrix that does it is the change-of-basis matrix.

examples.en: A change of basis is just a translation between two people's coordinate systems.
examples.ja: 基底の変換は、2 人の座標系のあいだの翻訳のようなものだ。

examples.en: Find the change-of-basis matrix from B to C.
examples.ja: B から C への基底変換行列を求めよ。

pitfalls: 用例コーパスの話し言葉は大半が 3Blue1Brown。

sources.title: W. Keith Nicholson, Linear Algebra with Applications (Lyryx, 2021A)
sources.note: 9.1 The Matrix of a Linear Transformation・9.2 Operators and Similarity
